description: Election Commission - Mrs. M. R. F. Safani of the Akurana Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated her Office of member  of that Pradeshiya Sabha , Mr. H. L. H. Rahuman  of the Pathahewaheta Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member of the Pradeshiya Sabha Mr. M. S. A. Ali of the Udunuwara Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific members of Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government bodies, making it clearly fall under the Elections category (Type 7) rather than government personnel changes or other specialized categories.
